description: A full buffer makes the producer wait, so memory and item age stay bounded by the consumers' speed.
`put` waits while full, `get` waits while empty; `maxsize=0` means unbounded and gives no backpressure.
Python 3.13: rejects new items; `get` drains what is queued, then raises `QueueShutDown` so consumers can stop.
Lets at most `n` tasks into a section at once; the standard-library form of a concurrency limit.
Serializes a critical section that contains an `await`, where another task could otherwise interleave.
Two tasks read the same value across an `await` and both write a value based on it; one write is lost.
